about: Labelled Wikimedia Commons photos for testing the meal recogniser. Each one was checked by eye. 'tuning' photos were used while writing the descriptions in dishes.json; 'test' photos were never looked at while tuning, so their score is the honest one. 'check' photos are other dishes, to make sure changes don't make them worse.
